description: Observations to Camden Council on 'Variation of conditions 2 (approved drawings), 6 (Whole Life Carbon), 21 (re details of gates/barriers), 27 (Circular Economy) and 32 (re end of journey arrangements plan) approved under planning permission reference 2025/1683/P on 5 June 2026 for ‘Remodelling, refurbishment and extension of the existing building to provide Use Class E (commercial, retail/restaurant and jewellery workspace), landscaped amenity terraces, balconies, relocated entrances, commuter facilities, on-site servicing yard and plant along with associated highway improvements and associated works’. Namely amendments to external façade, demolition of columns, updated ground levels to corner of Charterhouse Street and Farringdon Road to match footway, partial demolition of ground floor level slab, internal reconfiguration and other associated works' (Camden ref: 2026/3192/P).
decision_conditions: Islington Council have no comments to make on this proposal.
